title: thymus serpyllum subvar. ericoides
intro: Thymus serpyllum subvar. ericoides, commonly known as creeping thyme or wild thyme, is a low-growing, spreading perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Thymus serpyllum subvar. ericoides include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antiseptic, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, immune system support, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum subvar. ericoides include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and traditional medicine.
